description: The file defines an ErrorHandler class responsible for capturing, formatting, and writing exception information into structured JSON error files within a distributed PyTorch Elastic training context. It manages error file paths, handles fault handlers, and provides mechanisms for overriding error codes associated with root causes.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: A handler class for capturing exceptions, formatting error data, and writing errors to designated files or logs, supporting customization via subclassing.

methods.name: str|None _get_error_file_path(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the path of the error file from environment variables; returns None if not set.

methods.name: None initialize(self)
methods.description: Prepares the error handler, typically by enabling fault signal handling.

methods.name: None _write_error_file(self, file_path: str, error_msg: str)
methods.description: Writes a specified error message to a given file path.

methods.name: None record_exception(self, e: BaseException)
methods.description: Captures exception details and writes structured info to the error file or logs if no file is specified.

methods.name: override_error_code_in_rootcause_data( self, rootcause_error_file: str, rootcause_error: dict[str, Any], error_code: int = 0, )
methods.description: Modifies the root cause error dictionary to set a proper error code.

methods.name: dump_error_file(self, rootcause_error_file: str, error_code: int = 0)
methods.description: Loads a root cause error JSON file, optionally updates its error code, and writes it to the designated error file.

methods.name: _rm(self, my_error_file)
methods.description: Removes the specified error file after logging its current contents.
